Former uses of tannic acid include application to burns, addition to barium sulfate enemas to improve the quality of radiological pictures of the colon, and as an ingredient of ‘Universal Anti- dote’. However, tannic acid has been associated with liver toxic- ity, sometimes fatal. Tattoo removal. Although tannic acid may be used by plastic surgeons and dermatologists to produce a controlled partial- thickness burn in tattoo removal1 it has been pointed out that in unskilled or amateur hands this procedure has resulted in full thickness burns requiring skin grafting to obtain satisfactory healing.2 1.
